issue.title: Keyboard popup view auto-scroll not working for <Textarea />

repository.name: NativeBase
repository.description: Mobile-first, accessible components for React Native & Web to build consistent UI across Android, iOS and Web.

issue.body:
`npm version 6.2.0`
`react-native 0.56.0`
`native-base 2.7.2`

I cannot get the soft keyboard popup to auto-align with input text position or cursor. The view doesn't autoscroll at all, and the keyboard covers the inputs.

With the following View layout:
`<Container>
  <Content padder enableAutomaticScroll>
    <Form>
      <Textarea rowSpan={5} />
      <Textarea rowSpan={5} />
      <Textarea rowSpan={5} />
      <Textarea rowSpan={5} />
    </Form>
  </Content>
</Container>`

Some screenshots of a textarea with and without the keyboard
![screen shot 2018-08-20 at 1 22 39 pm](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8226402/44364560-2fd22000-a47c-11e8-8fc0-c8d00558d953.png)
![screen shot 2018-08-20 at 1 22 51 pm](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8226402/44364561-2fd22000-a47c-11e8-846e-cfb8f5409c60.png)

It's at least present in iOS.

Any thoughts?

body: Hey there, it looks like there has been no activity on this issue recently. Has the issue been fixed, or does it still require the community's attention? This issue may be closed if no further activity occurs. You may also label this issue as "For Discussion" or "Good first issue" and I will leave it open. Thank you for your contributions.
